'''Docking bay 51''' was a landing bay that was located in [[Greentree Pointe]] resort on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] landed their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in docking bay 51, after traveling to Dorumaa to counter a protection racket that had been established by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]].
